dslRule:
<!id: scrollbar.getVisible>
<!description: Replace Control.isVisible() with Widget.getVisible() for ScrollBar instances.>
<!severity: HINT>

$bar.isVisible() :: instanceof($bar, "org.eclipse.swt.widgets.ScrollBar")
=>
$bar.getVisible()
;;
